target_segments: Live attenuated vaccine within 30 days before the first dose, unless administered as part of standard institutional practice for seasonal influenza.

text_span: unless administered as part of standard institutional practice for seasonal influenza
sub_criteria.rationale: H4: removing this phrase restores the broader exclusion of live attenuated vaccination within 30 days. The phrase waives that exclusion for vaccines administered under standard institutional practice for seasonal influenza; the explicit trigger 'unless' is included (X3).
